review_notes.four_rounds: Every round found a real defect the previous fix had introduced. Round 1: a file licence attributed to the first function -- documenting a lie. Round 2: the fix swallowed the first function's own legitimate doc. Round 3: an anchor suffix colliding with a real symbol, and a fourth case the round-three signal stopped covering. Round 4 approved.
review_notes.final_rule: The conjunction of three signals -- no symbol resolved, no stray note filed, no code executed. Each single signal alone covered three of the four cases and broke the fourth silently.
review_notes.declared_cost: One residual case, written in docs/specs/AUR-464.md with a four-case table: a script whose very first executable line is a documented function, with nothing above it, still files that doc under Script Notes.
review_notes.reviewer_own_mutation: Weakening the conjunction by removing strayNotes==0 dropped TestAUR464 alone at the overview_blank_then_doc subtest; restoring reproduced the exact green.
review_notes.followup: A bash function whose body opens and closes on the same physical line is not recognised at all -- matchBashFunction only matches a body opening on its own line. Confirmed by the reviewer, a common shape, and outside this card's scope.
